description: Search/browse AniList's activity feed (list updates, text posts, messages), optionally filtered to one user or — with `isFollowing` [Requires login] — to your following feed, to one or more activity types, and/or to a creation-time window. Each result already includes its full content (text/message/status, `replyCount`/`likeCount`/`isLiked`, the posting user, and — for list activity — the media) — no follow-up get_activity call needed unless you need to re-check one specific result's `replyCount`/`likeCount`/`isLiked` later (e.g. after liking it).

createdAfter.description: Only activity created strictly after this ISO 8601 datetime with an offset (e.g. "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z"); compared at whole-second precision.

createdBefore.description: Only activity created strictly before this ISO 8601 datetime.

isFollowing.description: [Requires login] Set true for your following feed: activity from users the logged-in account follows plus its own (AniList's `isFollowing` filter — confirmed live: an account following nobody gets only its own activity). Without a token this errors before any request rather than returning the global feed. Can't be combined with `user`. false or omitted means no restriction.

page.description: Page number for pagination. AniList's paginated connections (search results, a title's characters/staff/reviews, activity feeds, forum comments) reject a page whose page × perPage exceeds ~5000 entries with an upstream error, so paging that deep fails rather than returning more results.

perPage.description: Results per page (max 50, AniList's own ceiling — it silently clamps anything higher).

type.description: Restrict to this activity type, or pass an array to match ANY of several (e.g. ["TEXT", "MESSAGE"]). MEDIA_LIST matches both ANIME_LIST and MANGA_LIST activities; use ANIME_LIST/MANGA_LIST to restrict to just one. Omit for every type.

user.description: Restrict results to this AniList user — numeric ID or exact username (resolved to an id with one extra internal lookup; no need to call search_user first unless you only have a partial/fuzzy name). An unknown ID or username errors with not_found rather than silently returning an empty result.

name: search_activity

lastPage.description: Not currently accurate (a known AniList performance limitation) — use `hasNextPage` instead to decide whether to fetch another page.

total.description: Not currently accurate (a known AniList performance limitation) — don't rely on it to decide whether to fetch more pages.

title: Search activity feed
